constraints.name: fk_installations_appointment
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments(company_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_installations_customer
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id) REFERENCES customers(company_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_installations_order
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, order_id) REFERENCES orders(company_id, customer_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: fk_wt_installation
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, customer_id, order_id, installation_id) REFERENCES installations(company_id, customer_id, order_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: installations_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: trg_installations_integrity
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_installations_integrity BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_installations_integrity()

triggers.name: trg_tenant_mutation_installations
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tenant_mutation_installations BEFORE UPDATE ON installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_tenant_mutation()

triggers.name: trg_updated_at_installations
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_updated_at_installations BEFORE UPDATE ON installations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()

indexes.name: idx_installations_status
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_installations_status ON public.installations USING btree (company_id, status)

indexes.name: installations_order_id_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX installations_order_id_key ON public.installations USING btree (order_id)

indexes.name: installations_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX installations_pkey ON public.installations USING btree (id)

indexes.name: uq_installations_company_customer_order_id
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_installations_company_customer_order_id ON public.installations USING btree (company_id, customer_id, order_id, id)
